title: What are Custom Instructions?

body.text: permanent instructions that apply to every conversation
without retyping them each time — like who you are, the tone you want, or whether answers should be short or long.

example: "Always answer in Thai, use simple language, avoid jargon, and include an example in every answer."

title: Setting up Custom Instructions

body.text: "about you" and "how you want ChatGPT to respond"
. Set them under Settings > Personalization > Custom Instructions — they take effect on every new conversation right away.

example: "I own a small food business (SME). When answering, keep in mind the budget constraints of a small business."

options.text: They apply only to the current conversation
They're permanent instructions that apply to every new conversation

question: How many parts do Custom Instructions have?

options.text: 2 parts: about you, and how you want ChatGPT to respond

question: What's the main benefit of Custom Instructions?

options.text: They make ChatGPT free to use with no limits
No retyping each time — ChatGPT remembers the behavior you want
